Name: Libni, Son of Mahli
Summary: Son of Mahli and father of Shimei in Merari's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:29: Son of Mahli and father of Shimei in Merari's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Libni stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
